how: Run `npm run facts` in site/ on a machine with the engine checkout, its venv, the dashboard's node_modules and gh signed in. It re-runs every command below and rewrites this file with today's date.

items.label: PRs written by the pipeline and merged
items.detail: 81 on MARVIN itself, 19 on Seal Speak. Counted as merged PRs whose branch starts with pipeline/.
items.command: gh pr list --state merged --limit 1000 --json headRefName (G-Eskayo/marvin and G-Eskayo/clarity-captions), count pipeline/*

items.label: tests
items.detail: 7,674 counted: 4,640 Python tests collected by pytest in lib/tests, plus 3,034 dashboard tests listed by vitest.
items.command: pytest lib/tests --collect-only -q; cd dashboard && npx vitest list | wc -l

items.label: skills it can load
items.detail: Playbooks in the public repo, one SKILL.md each.

items.label: machines, one system
items.detail: A MacBook Pro, a Mac mini, and a 2012 Mac mini running Linux.
items.command: the machine list in the network config; the Linux box's timers checked over ssh

items.label: merged PRs on the engine
items.detail: Every merged PR on G-Eskayo/marvin, written by the pipeline or in a session with the owner, since the first merge on 27 August 2026.
items.command: gh pr list -R G-Eskayo/marvin --state merged --limit 2000 --json number | length
